thag3.8:1.1: Eko pi saddho medhāvī asaddhān' idha ñātinaṃ dhammaṭṭho sīlasampanno hoti atthāya bandhunaṃ. || ||
thag3.8:2.1: niggayha anukampāya coditā ñātayo mayā ñātibandhavapemena kāraṃ katvāna bhikkhusu. || ||
thag3.8:3.1: te abbhatītā kālakatā pattā te tidivaṃ sukhaṃ, bhātaro mayhaṃ mātā ca modanti kāmakāmino 'ti. || || Passikathero.
